purpose: Sole runtime reference table: complete attributed exact conventional-cell representatives, one selected IUCr reference setting for each ordinary space-group type.
scope: All 230 ordinary 3D space-group types; one selected IUCr reference setting per type, not all settings or magnetic/layer/rod groups.

conventions.rotation_storage: rotations[id] is a row-major integer 3x3 matrix
conventions.cell_representatives: 0<=t_i<1; complete representatives G/T_cell; T_cell={T_n:n in Z^3}
conventions.full_group: Every element is uniquely T_n*r_i=(R_i,n+t_i). Retain n in full affine algebra.
conventions.full_translation_subgroup: T={T_(n+c):n in Z^3,c in centering_t24/24}; not generally T_cell
conventions.reference_setting: monoclinic unique b/cell1; origin2 when available; rhombohedral hexagonal axes; remaining axes/origins exactly Hall/xyz; current_to_reference=(I,0)
conventions.hermann_mauguin: current COMCIFS reference labels, including e-glide names; source_hermann_mauguin preserves Gemmi legacy labels; :h and :H denote hexagonal axes
